title: Gravity and Static
author: Rosalind Almeida
blurb: Sable Delacroix, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
